# Robot Precision and Zero Turn Muscle: Toro’s 2027 Residential Mower Collection


### Toro has your lawn care covered, whether you’re touching the handles or not


Oct 14, 2026 |[Homeowner](https://newsroom.toro.com/en/homeowner)


-
-
-


From robotic to riding, Toro, America’s #1 Walk Mower Brand*, is bringing two completely different ways to dominate your lawn in 2027. The new HAVEN® AM75 autonomous mower is the easy-to-use, reliable solution that takes traditional mowing work completely off the homeowner's to-do list. The newly refreshed Toro® TimeCutter® zero turn lineup is built for bigger yards and tighter storage, including a new compact 50-inch model that saves up to 20% on storage space^ without sacrificing cutting width.


“Lawn care isn't one-size-fits-all, so we built two differentiated solutions to solve two very real homeowner challenges: taking back your time with set-and-forget robotic tech, and maximizing garage real estate without giving up an ounce of power or cutting width,” says Jens Hoffman, senior marketing manager at Toro. “No two yards are alike, and no two homeowners manage them the same way. Our 2027 releases give you the best of both worlds.”


**HAVEN® AM75 Autonomous Mower**


Designed for properties up to three-quarters of an acre, the HAVEN AM75 autonomous mower is powered by a LiDAR-guided navigation system specifically engineered to maintain a pristine, always-ready lawn. Its auto-mapping feature detects where the grass ends to build its own map. If the lawn lacks defined edges, homeowners can steer the unit around the desired perimeter using a mobile app that works like a remote-control car to establish the mower’s boundaries. HAVEN AM75 can easily handle hills and slopes, cross driveways and sidewalks to reach separate lawn areas, and allows homeowners to set custom “exclusion zones” to steer clear of flower beds, gardens or newly seeded grass.


The autonomous mower relies on 360-degree situational awareness powered by LiDAR laser technology and camera obstacle detection to continuously learn and adapt to the contours of the yard over time. It safely detects and navigates around pets, children and toys. Built-in weather sensors also detect rain, ensuring the mower only operates when the grass is dry.


Unlike many startup robotic brands, the HAVEN AM75 is backed by the trusted reputation and long-standing heritage of the Toro brand. Homeowners gain access to reliable warranties, ongoing product support, routine maintenance and expert service through Toro’s extensive nationwide network of authorized dealers.


**Refreshed TimeCutter® Series of Zero Turn Mowers**


The refreshed TimeCutter lineup incorporates several upgrades across every model, including styling that mirrors the bold, sculpted front-end design of Toro’s premium options for a look that commands attention from the curb. An aggressive tire tread pattern delivers enhanced traction and control, while a redesigned high-back seat features custom bolstering to provide superior operator support during longer mows. Additionally, a low-step front-end design makes getting on and off the mower quick and effortless.


The lineup offers versatile options for every yard layout:


- **34-Inch Twin Cylinder, Fabricated Deck:** For homeowners with tight yard access or narrow storage constraints, featuring an ultra-compact footprint engineered specifically to navigate standard residential backyard gates.


- **42-Inch Single Cylinder, Stamped Deck:** For homeowners transitioning from walk-behind or tractor mowers, combining zero turn speed and easy maneuverability for faster mowing on suburban yards.


- **42-Inch Twin Cylinder, Stamped Deck:** For midsize yards needing extra cutting muscle, pairing an upgraded engine’s power with a smooth stamped deck for faster cuts through thicker rass.


- **42-Inch Twin Cylinder, Fabricated Deck:** For property owners facing rough terrain or heavy debris, featuring a heavy-duty welded, fabricated deck built to hold up season after season.


- **50-Inch Twin Cylinder, Fabricated Deck:** For larger properties up to two acres, maximizing cutting width on a narrow, space-saving chassis with a heavy-duty welded deck built for long-term durability.


With the HAVEN AM75 autonomous mower and refreshed TimeCutter lineup, homeowners can choose the right combination of convenience, capability and performance to ensure lawn care is never a chore and always a job well done. Homeowners can find both the HAVEN AM75 autonomous mower and the refreshed TimeCutter series at authorized Toro dealers,[toro.com](http://toro.com/) and major retail partners starting in 2027. For more information, visit toro.com.
